fusions.name: Talons-First Stoop
fusions.desc: You swoop up to 7 tiles onto the target and drag your talons through it for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Flung Litter
fusions.desc: A wingbeat flings the gathered litter through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Nest
fusions.desc: Heaps a nest where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Rook in the Wake
fusions.desc: A bonded bird fights beside you, striking an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.
